context: The eval checks whether the maintainability lens stays focused on misleading helper contracts as a real defect when they make a caller easy to misuse.

checklist.name: Finds the unchecked promise and access bypass
checklist.description: States that settings.patch no longer awaits or checks assertWorkspaceAccess, so settings.update can run before access is verified

checklist.name: Connects the bug to the misleading contract
checklist.description: Explains that assertWorkspaceAccess now returns boolean instead of preserving its prior throw-on-failure behavior, making caller misuse likely

checklist.name: Gives a structural fix
checklist.description: Proposes restoring throw-on-failure semantics, renaming to hasWorkspaceAccess and requiring an explicit branch, or otherwise narrowing the API so callers cannot ignore the result

checklist.name: Names the security impact without overgeneralizing
checklist.description: Identifies unauthorized settings updates as the impact and avoids generic advice about authentication

checklist.name: Uses local contract evidence
checklist.description: References concrete evidence for the contract, such as the assertWorkspaceAccess name, the previous throw-on-failure behavior, or the changed route previously awaiting the helper before updating settings

checklist.name: Avoids readability and style distractions
checklist.description: Does not treat the workspaceId local variable, missing return type annotations, or generic async style commentary as review findings
